prompt_text: Reference 1 is geometry/camera guide only; reference 2 is a verified same-kit wall face guide; reference 3 is the canonical target source contact and controls all materials and identity. Produce a transparent atlas with TWO rows (outer corner first, inner corner second) and FOUR equal cells per row in order FRONT, RIGHT, LEFT, REAR. Each cell is a level axis-aligned broad rectangular elevation of the joined corner walls with matching total height; no L-shaped elevation, no single post, no isometric or visible top plane. Keep the same compact L corner construction and branch orientation. Outer row preserves the source outer corner's red/gold corner badge and cyan/red band layout; inner row preserves the source inner corner's two corner badges, pale masonry, cyan and red trim bands. Do not add extra badges or wall bays. Hidden surfaces inferred consistently. Crisp orthographic pixel art with transparent background, no floor, text, shadows or cell bleed.
